hypothesis: Add rich user profile/social-graph fields (user_active_degree, follow/fans/friend_user_num_range, register_days_range, cleaned is_live_streamer, is_video_author) from user_features_pure.csv as new categorical FM fields — per EDA's "unused data available" note, these are currently completely unjoined, and richer user-side signal should help personalization especially for the ~30-36% of users the current user_id-only embedding sees rarely, without touching the model or training loop.
expected_effect: GAUC should move more than nDCG@5, since these are per-user static features that primarily improve within-user ranking discrimination (the metric most sensitive to better personalization for sparse/cold users), while nDCG@5's top-of-list ranking is more item-popularity-driven and less affected by user-side features.
